description: List log files of an instance (GET /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}/instances/{instanceName}/logs): name, logType, fileSize, lastModifiedDateTime, lastFile (currently written). Sort fields: name, lastModifiedDateTime, fileSize.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

pageNo.description: Page number, 0-based (default 0 — note: unlike the legacy Ncloud APIs)

sort.description: Sort keys 'field,asc|desc' (repeatable; allowed fields per tool)

name: ncloud_serverless_list_logs
